_comment: Meta 1 of block 31, selected by the override in minecraft:item/grass. The sprite is the terrain
atlas one StationAPI unstitches under the name block/grass (assets/minecraft/stationapi/atlases/
game.json), which is the same greyscale tall-grass texture the world uses - so it needs the same
tint the world gives it, supplied by StationApiItemColors through item/generated's tintindex 0.
